lead_raw_text:
The orthorhombic crystal Gd4Mg10Mo2 (Gd2Mg5Mo) adopts space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed across six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Gd centers with 16 geometric neighbors (12 Mg, 4 Mo), while Mg centers display several environments, including a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 neighbors (2 Gd, 10 Mg). Mo centers have 8 Mg neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Mg-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Gd and Mg polyhedra.
